title: Cherry Pickup
problemStatement: Given an N × N grid containing cherries, empty cells, and blocked cells, determine the maximum number of cherries that can be collected by traveling from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner and then returning to the starting cell without collecting the same cherry more than once.
input: • First line contains integer N. • Next N lines each contain N integers representing the grid.
output: Print the maximum number of cherries that can be collected.
